defense_news.title: Missiles, satellites and warplanes — Ukraine, Europe advance key arms projects
defense_news.summary: Ukraine’s Fire Point said the firm is developing an extended-range tactical ballistic missile after its FP-7 weapon was used in combat for the first time.

defense_news.title: US removes B-1 bombers from UK base amid security concerns
defense_news.summary: The United States removed its B-1 bombers from a U.K. air base one week after several men were arrested there on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.

defense_news.title: Yemeni government launches offensive to seize all areas from Iran-backed Houthis
defense_news.summary: Yemen’s Saudi-backed government said on Sunday it was launching a major military campaign to recapture all areas controlled by the Iran-backed Houthis.

defense_news.title: Saudis plan assault on Houthis to break Red Sea chokehold
defense_news.summary: More than 100,000 Yemeni troops could be mobilized in the offensive, depending on the scale, officials said.

geo_news.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan AileFest'i ziyaret etti
